name: The People's Militia
summary: Westfall's volunteers face a growing Defias threat. Led by Gryan Stoutmantle, The People's Militia now confronts thieves who have moved beyond highway robbery to ransack Moonbrook and the Gold Coast Quarry. The Militia calls for harsher retaliation.

sections.title: Escalating Violence
sections.body: Defias attacks have spread from the roads to Westfall's economic centers. Defias Looters and Pillagers, who hurl fire, occupy Moonbrook and the Gold Coast Quarry. They strip the Alexston Farmstead as well. Gryan Stoutmantle sees what their hold on these places could mean: Westfall may become impossible to reclaim without a formal royal army.

sections.title: The Militia's Philosophy
sections.body: Stormwind has sent Gryan Stoutmantle neither soldiers nor supplies. So he calls on the Holy Light and the resolve of Westfall's remaining farmers. Volunteers carry the fight into Defias strongholds, wearing down the Brotherhood. Driving out the looters will deny them resources and show fearful residents that defenders still fight for Westfall's peace and prosperity.

faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle organized the People's Militia as an armed volunteer force to defend Westfall. Its ranks draw largely from displaced Westfall farmers and sympathetic travelers. They formed to resist the Defias Brotherhood after Stormwind's royal court refused to send city guards.

Gryan Stoutmantle is a veteran human commander who leads Westfall's defense from the redoubt atop Sentinel Hill. Dedicated to the Light and his home, he directs the People's Militia's desperate resistance to outlaw control.

faq.q: Why are the Defias looting farms and quarries?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood seeks to cripple Westfall's food supply and seize raw materials. By taking the Gold Coast Quarry, they control stone and minerals. Capturing Moonbrook and farmsteads drives off honest folk and gives them bases for their criminal enterprise.

faq.q: Why hasn't Stormwind sent soldiers to Westfall?
faq.answer: Stormwind has sent no soldiers because King Varian Wrynn has mysteriously vanished. The boy-king Anduin sits on the throne under Highlord Bolvar Fordragon's regency. Gridlock in the noble House of Nobles stretches crown resources thin, leaving outlying territories like Westfall to local defenders.

faq.q: Where are Defias Pillagers and Looters found?
faq.answer: Defias Pillagers and Looters gather around captured settlements in southern and western Westfall. They are found in the abandoned town of Moonbrook, the Gold Coast Quarry along the western bluffs, and the ruined Alexston Farmstead.

angles.text: As an Alliance fighter, you see the bitter divide between Stormwind City's comfortable walls and its starving borderlands, left entirely to their own devices.
As a paladin, you hear Gryan Stoutmantle call on the Light to purge Westfall of criminal corruption. This campaign is a direct mission of justice for you.
As a human, you face a tragic struggle against former stonemasons and neighbors who have turned violently against their own people.
